info.name: NGINX njs Scripting Connections Workers API
NGINX Return Statistics for All Worker Processes

params.name: fields
params.description: Limits which fields of worker process statistics will be output.

items.docs: Returns statistics for all worker processes such as accepted, dropped, active, idle connections, total and current requests.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for All Worker Processes

items.docs:
Resets statistics for all worker processes such as
accepted, dropped, active, idle connections, total and current requests.

info.name: NGINX Return Status of a Worker Process

params.name: workerId
params.description: The ID of the worker process.

params.name: fields
params.description: Limits which fields of worker process statistics will be output.

items.docs: Returns status of a particular worker process.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for a Worker Process

params.name: workerId
params.description: The ID of the worker process.

items.docs:
Resets statistics of accepted, dropped, active, idle connections,
as well as total and current requests.
